evals.prompt: Use nvshmem-tune-performance to help me improve NVSHMEM performance. I do not have a concrete tuning question yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent presents a baseline-characterization workflow and a targeted-optimization workflow covering remote transport, NIC-to-PE mapping, and TMA, then requires an explicit selection without running anything.
assertions: The agent offers initial performance data collection as an optional first step rather than an automatic prerequisite
The agent lists remote transport selection, NIC-to-PE mapping, and TMA as the three targeted optimization domains
The agent does not invoke a specialist, run a collector, execute a benchmark, or choose an optimization without user input

evals.prompt: Use nvshmem-tune-performance. I want to collect initial NVSHMEM performance data and system information first, then choose an optimization. I have not selected a benchmark suite yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes nvshmem-collect-performance-data, which presents its benchmark-suite choices and waits for an explicit selection before running anything; no optimizer is chosen yet.
assertions: The agent routes the request to nvshmem-collect-performance-data
The agent preserves the collector's requirement that the user explicitly select a benchmark or suite before execution
The agent does not invoke an optimization skill before collection completes and the user chooses an optimization

evals.prompt: Use nvshmem-tune-performance to choose an NVSHMEM remote transport for a two-node InfiniBand application. Skip benchmarking and make a static recommendation from my installation facts and kernel profile.
evals.expected_output: The agent directly invokes nvshmem-select-remote-transport with the supplied goal and evidence, without inserting performance data collection.
assertions: The agent routes directly to nvshmem-select-remote-transport
The handoff includes the two-node InfiniBand target, static-analysis constraint, installation facts, and kernel profile
The agent does not invoke performance data collection or claim a measured performance winner

evals.prompt: Use nvshmem-tune-performance to optimize the NIC-to-PE mapping for my selected IBGDA transport. I already have the NVSHMEM version, local PE-to-GPU bindings, and target-node topology output.
evals.expected_output: The agent directly invokes nvshmem-configure-nic-pe-mapping and passes the established transport, version, PE-to-GPU binding, and topology evidence.
assertions: The agent routes directly to nvshmem-configure-nic-pe-mapping
The handoff preserves the selected IBGDA transport and all supplied mapping evidence
The agent does not rerun transport selection or performance collection

evals.prompt: Use nvshmem-tune-performance to assess and prepare src/exchange.cu for NVSHMEM TMA on H100 GPUs connected by NVLink. Do not run a benchmark.
evals.expected_output: The agent directly invokes nvshmem-enable-tma with the selected source scope, H100/NVLink facts, assessment-and-preparation goal, and no-benchmark constraint.
assertions: The agent routes directly to nvshmem-enable-tma
The handoff preserves src/exchange.cu as the selected source scope and includes the H100 and NVLink evidence
The agent does not route TMA through a remote transport skill or insert performance data collection

evals.prompt: Use nvshmem-tune-performance to select the best eligible remote transport for my target and then produce the matching NIC-to-PE mapping. Do not run benchmarks.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes nvshmem-select-remote-transport first and, after a transport is resolved, invokes nvshmem-configure-nic-pe-mapping with the selection evidence and unresolved conditions.
assertions: The agent sequences nvshmem-select-remote-transport before nvshmem-configure-nic-pe-mapping
The mapping handoff includes the selected transport, version, provider and relevant topology evidence or unresolved prerequisites
The agent does not invoke performance data collection

evals.prompt: Use nvshmem-tune-performance to tune my NIC-to-PE mapping, but nvshmem-configure-nic-pe-mapping is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: The agent names the missing nvshmem-configure-nic-pe-mapping dependency, explains that mapping cannot proceed, and asks the user to install or expose it or select another service without inventing a mapping.
assertions: The agent explicitly reports that nvshmem-configure-nic-pe-mapping is unavailable
The agent does not reconstruct the missing specialist's mapping algorithm or emit mapping exports
The agent offers to continue after the dependency is available or with another listed service

evals.prompt: How should I tune NCCL all-reduce bucket sizes for a PyTorch training job that does not use NVSHMEM?
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes an unrelated NCCL and PyTorch question and does not invoke nvshmem-tune-performance or any routed NVSHMEM skill.
assertions: The agent does not invoke nvshmem-tune-performance or an NVSHMEM specialist
The response addresses or scopes the NCCL and PyTorch question directly
The agent does not introduce NVSHMEM transport, mapping, benchmark, or TMA guidance
